detail: One row per independent participant, according to the supplied design; independence cannot be tested from these data.
No missing values in id, group, or outcome; all rows were analyzed.
Larger-to-smaller sample variance ratio = 1.13; Welch inference allows unequal variances.
Inspect diagnostic-plot.png. Shapiro-Wilk p-values: A=0.954, B=0.852; with n=12 per group these have limited power and are not an assumption gate.
Leave-one-out B-minus-A estimates range from 3.55 to 4.11 points (full estimate 3.83).
